actor_id.description: Required for mut.* entries. Identity of the actor that performed the mutation.

authority_rank.description: Optional for src.* entries. Precedence when multiple sources provide the same subject (lower = higher authority).

capability_id.description: Required for mut.* entries. Capability that authorized the mutation.

category.description: Operational category. Determines which additional fields are required.

component_type.description: OSCAL component-type vocabulary. Reuse OSCAL nouns — do not invent new types.

consumer_surface.description: Required for exp.* entries. The consumer-facing surface this artifact is rendered on.

control_refs.description: OSCAL control IDs satisfied by this artifact. Compliance detail belongs here, not in the subid string.

control_source.description: URI of the OSCAL catalog or profile that provides the control baseline.

dbus_path.description: Required for prj.* entries. D-Bus object path of the projected artifact.

event_hash.description: Required for evt.* entries. Content hash of the event for chain verification.

event_id.description: Required for evt.* entries. Unique identifier for this event in the audit chain.

facet.description: Optional additional qualifier (up to two segments). Lowercase hyphenated.

idempotency_key.description: Required for mut.* entries. Deduplication key for the mutation operation.

proof_root.description: Optional for evt.* entries. Merkle proof root for chain verification.

query_scope.description: Required for obs.* entries. D-Bus path pattern or scope expression for this observation.

schema_hash.description: Required for sch.* entries. Content hash of the schema at this version.

schema_id.description: Required for sch.* entries. Canonical name of the schema.

service_name.description: Required for prj.* entries. D-Bus service name hosting the object.

source_locator.description: Required for src.* entries. Socket path, URL, or address of the source.

source_subid.description: Optional for prj.* entries. Subid of the src.* record this projection was derived from.

source_system.description: Required for src.* entries. Name of the authoritative source system.

statement_refs.description: Optional fine-grained OSCAL statement-level references within the controls.

subid.description: Human-readable operational taxonomy key. Format: <category>.<component-type>.<subject>.<verb>\[.<facet>\]\[@vN\]. Immutable per subject.

subject.description: Stable noun identifying the artifact (e.g. state-sync, plugin-schema). Lowercase hyphenated.

tags_touched.description: Required for evt.* entries. Tags whose immutability is affected by this event.

tool_name.description: Required for exp.mcp-tool entries. The MCP tool name as registered.

uuid.description: Machine identity UUID (RFC 4122). Never replaced by subid.

verb.description: Action performed on the subject (e.g. apply-patch, resolve, monitor). Lowercase hyphenated.

version.description: Schema version of this subid (the @vN suffix). Increment only when subject meaning changes materially.
